changelog: Since v0.14.14: setup-overlay countdown pill fixed (was rendering behind the QR backdrop); ticker/demo-mode no longer permanently muted on wired-ethernet devices whose WiFi hotspot stays up; hotspot SSID label no longer gets wiped by a later socket update; Check for Firmware Update no longer reports an older manifest version as "available", and the updater itself now refuses to install anything that isn't actually newer; m3u playlist import redesigned (own section, optional http://, default pinclock.m3u filename); Clock tab now comes before Video; Upload Video/Import Playlist/Check for Firmware Update now prompt to connect to WiFi first when on the setup hotspot; WiFi auto-connect toggle updates immediately on a successful connect; reconnecting to WiFi while viewing the control page at the hotspot's bare IP now shows the mDNS address (or QR-code fallback) needed to reach it afterward; "Nearby WiFi Networks" renamed.
